---
title: "2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate Election"
---

Interactive county-level results from the November 3, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate election (data from the NC State Board of Elections). Hover or click any county to see vote totals and percentages.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Read precinct results from the NCSBE zip file and sum US Senate votes by county
senate_county <- read_tsv(
  unz("data/results_pct_20261103.zip", "results_pct_20261103.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  summarize(
    dem_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "DEM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "REP"], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = County
  ) |>
  mutate(
    dem_pct = dem_votes / total_votes * 100,
    rep_pct = rep_votes / total_votes * 100,
    # Positive = Cooper (DEM) lead; negative = Whatley (REP) lead
    dem_margin = dem_pct - rep_pct
  )

# Download NC county shapes, convert to WGS84 for leaflet, and join vote totals
nc_map <- counties(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(County = str_to_upper(NAME)) |>
  left_join(senate_county, by = "County") |>
  mutate(
    label_html = paste0(
      "<strong>", NAME, " County</strong><br/>",
      "Roy Cooper (DEM): ", scales::comma(dem_votes),
      " (", sprintf("%.1f%%", dem_pct), ")<br/>",
      "Michael Whatley (REP): ", scales::comma(rep_votes),
      " (", sprintf("%.1f%%", rep_pct), ")<br/>",
      "Total votes: ", scales::comma(total_votes)
    ) |>
      map(htmltools::HTML)
  )

# Symmetric red-blue color scale centered at a 0% tie
max_margin <- max(abs(nc_map$dem_margin), na.rm = TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "RdBu",
  domain = c(-max_margin, max_margin)
)

leaflet(nc_map) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~ pal(dem_margin),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "#444444",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~label_html,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5,
      color = "#000000",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = c(-max_margin, max_margin),
    title = "Margin (DEM - REP)",
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%")
  )
```
